author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Refactored Generator::generate() into 3 explicit passes so leaf-and-parent NSIDs land their content in <path>/mod.rs instead of <path>.rs.

Code change in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs::Generator::generate():
  PASS 1: build the full mod_tree from every NSID (so PASS 2 knows which NSIDs are also parents).
  PASS 2: per doc, if the NSID's path is a key in mod_tree (it has child NSIDs), write content to <path>/mod.rs; otherwise write to <path>.rs as before.
  PASS 3: emit each directory's mod.rs. If PASS 2 already wrote leaf content there (the leaf-and-parent case), append the mod-tree directives below it rather than overwrite. Otherwise write the standard \"// Generated\" header + directives.

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo test -p proto-blue-codegen                                  PASS (19 tests)
  cargo build --workspace                                           PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                            PASS (67 suites, 0 failures)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings             PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                           PASS

Wild-corpus rustc-compile pass against the 420-doc app+chat+com+tools slice (the slice that originally surfaced this bug, scraped 2026-05-08): the 3 instances of E0761 (com.deckbelcher.richtext, com.alephcubed.starmark.review, app.beaconbits.beacon) are GONE. All three former colliding pairs now produce a single <path>/mod.rs file containing both the leaf def's content AND pub mod <child>; declarations for the child NSIDs.

Remaining test failures on that slice are unrelated:
  - 12 x E0433 cannot find community/org in crate — partial-corpus artifacts (cross-TLD refs to community.* / org.* not in the slice). Would resolve with a complete scrape.
  - 1 x parse error from a multi-line lexicon description losing /// continuation. Filed separately as #25.

Behavioural change: bundled corpus regenerated; 229 generated files changed. No existing functionality affected — the bundled bsky/atproto/chat/tools corpus contains no leaf-and-parent NSIDs, so the bundled regen output retains the same compile semantics.

Category: A (root-cause) — restructured the entire generate() flow into passes so the leaf-and-parent invariant is enforced by construction, rather than papering over the symptom at one site.
